  PROBLEM: The new Issue #10059 tests and their helpers come after the `if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main())` guard at lines 35071-35072, so `main()` runs before any of them is defined. The affected names are `test_completion_status_closed_as_delivered_warns_once`, `test_completion_status_closed_not_planned_keeps_critical`, `test_completion_status_mixed_closed_kinds_keeps_critical`, `_closed_kind_state`, `_run_closed_kind_poller`, `_completion_comment`, `_closed_without_merge_criticals`, `_delivered_warnings` and `_CLOSED_DELIVERED_JUDGE_JSON`.
  WHY: CI parses the whole module with `ast.parse` to list tests (ci.yml lines 3658-3665) and runs them by name (ci.yml line 3689; also mark-stable.yml lines 397/420 and test-and-mark-stable.yml lines 3309/3332), but `main()` builds `tests_by_name` from `globals()` (lines 31207-31211), so it prints "FAIL <name>: unknown test name" and returns 1, failing the whole shard and the stable gate. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER, mapped here to critical.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:34535-34543 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_csc_delivered_lines="${_csc_failed_lines}"` is dead code because the jq result overwrites it on the next line, but its value is still the jq fallback (`|| printf '%s' "${_csc_delivered_lines}"`), so a jq failure would list the failed or closed-without-merge items under "Wave issues closed as already delivered".
  WHY: The impact is limited to the jq-error path, and both reviewers rated it NIT (confidence 3 and 4). minimax_minimax-m3 raised it as a hardening suggestion (fix: drop the assignment and use `|| printf ''`). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it as no defect: the fallback runs only when ANY_FAILED=true and ANY_FAILED_BLOCKING=false, so every closed item is `closed_as_delivered` and the lists match.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:3829 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `issue_state_reasons_raw = json.loads(args.issue_state_reasons_json)` has no `try...except JSONDecodeError`.
  WHY: Malformed JSON crashes with a traceback instead of returning the structured `{"ok": false, ...}` error (rated NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as a defense-in-depth hardening suggestion only, because the sibling arguments also call `json.loads` directly and the only shell producer always emits valid JSON.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: The new tests and helpers sit after the module-level `raise SystemExit(main())`, so `main()` runs and exits before any of the new `def` statements.

  WHY: Suggested fix: check for `[]` first, then emit `::warning::[completion-status] delivered-closed items could not be enumerated` and log `alert=none`. About 4 lines.

  PROBLEM: Malformed JSON raises a traceback instead of the structured `{"ok": false}` error.
  WHY: Defense in depth only: the sibling arguments match and the only shell producer always emits valid JSON. Suggested fix: try/except `json.JSONDecodeError`. About 5 lines.
- NOTES (3 related items): Rejected minimax's NIT on the `printf '%s' "${_csc_delivered_lines}"` fallback as no defect, because the fallback list matches the delivered list. Found no gate change: the only reader of `<!-- status:failed -->` is `completion_status_comment_failed_state_observation` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 4634), which is called only at line 33693. `refresh_validation_dispatch_wave_gate` (line 4662) calls check-wave-status without reasons, so it fails closed and is unchanged.
